items.text: Alexandra Briseno is an electrical engineer who works in legislative affairs for the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power, tracking state policies and pursuing grant money. She is the chairperson of the Montebello Civil Service Commission and previously chaired the city’s Planning Commission. Her campaign says she helped update the General Plan and organize the passage of the Hillside Viewshed Preservation Ordinance. Her campaign says she supports policies to strengthen families, expand opportunity, and make everyday life more affordable.
